info.title: Group 9 Project Management API
info.description: Development identity is NOT authentication. Explicit NODE_ENV=development or test and DEV_IDENTITY_ENABLED=true are required. Never enable it for a public deployment. All dates are timezone-qualified ISO 8601 instants, stored as PostgreSQL timestamptz and returned in UTC. Lists are paginated (default 20, max 100). Subtasks count independently; no automatic parent roll-up. See README for the provisional permission matrix and membership-history policy.

DevelopmentIdentity.description: NOT authentication. Use a fictional seeded user UUID only in explicit development/test mode.
